name: Mind Body Life
summary:
Discover a healthier, happier you with Mind Body Life by Add-Life.
Our platform provides simple daily activities designed to inspire movement, improve mental health, and support independent living.

Mind Body Life also empowers you to track your progress with precise measurements of arm reach, wrist, and hand movements. These insights are invaluable for those in rehabilitation or aged care, offering mobility reports that help clinicians and families plan for current and future needs.
